predecessors.name: Kingdom of Yugoslavia (Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes)
predecessors.text: Montenegro, Yugoslav since the union of 1918; Italian troops 'moved through on 16 April' 1941 and infobox 'Italian occupation: 18 April 1941'

successors.name: Yugoslav Partisans
successors.text: the Partisans 'liberated Risan and Podgorica between October and December' 1944 (Axis occupation page); German forces 'withdrew in December 1944'

ledger.cpn: Kingdom of Yugoslavia (Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes)

ledger.x: 18 April 1941: Italian military government of Montenegro begins.
12 July 1941: independence is declared and a restored Kingdom of Montenegro is proclaimed under an Italian regent.
3 October 1941: the occupied territory is retitled the Governorate of Montenegro.
December 1944: occupied Montenegro ends with the German withdrawal and the Partisans' advance.

wars.name: 13 July uprising
wars.outcome: A general uprising against the Italians, 'initiated by the Montenegrin branch of the KPJ', begins on 13 July 1941 and ends the puppet Kingdom of Montenegro (independence cancelled 24 July 1941); the page does not say how long the insurgents held ground.

certainty.note: The pages name what was cut off (the Bay of Kotor to Dalmatia, western and central Kosovo and the Plav-Gusinje area to Albania) but give no lines; the Sandžak edge (Tutin, Rožaje) is not located.
